text: Appeal of Order to Comply (November 12, 2018) for 51 Cowan Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Deferred consideration of the Order to Comply, dated November 12, 2018, regarding the property located at 51 Cowan Avenue, Folder No. 18 254785 PRS 00 IV to the March 25, 2019 meeting, and suggest that the owner of 51 Cowan Avenue work together with Municipal Standards Officer upon completion of the Order.
